What Is Countertop Protection Film?

Countertop protection film is a clear, sacrificial polyester film applied to stone, quartz, marble, granite, laminate, and solid-surface countertops. It absorbs scratches, stains, etching, and daily wear — then peels off cleanly and is replaced. Two specs we stock: Nexfil 4 mil anti-graffiti polyester (standard) and Solyx clear protective film lines (range of finishes and thicknesses). Both peel-and-replace, no adhesive residue when removed within the replacement window.

Frequently Asked Questions — Oregon & Washington

What is countertop protection film?

Countertop protection film is a clear, self-adhesive polyurethane or polyester film applied to stone, quartz, laminate, and solid-surface countertops to protect against scratches, stains, UV yellowing, and daily wear. Quality film uses 4 mil sacrificial polyester that peels off cleanly when worn, scratched, or damaged — no adhesive residue. Replacement is fast and cost-effective compared to refinishing or resealing stone surfaces.

Does countertop protection film work on quartz and marble?

Yes. Countertop protection film is compatible with quartz, marble, granite, laminate, quartzite, and solid-surface countertops. The film is optically clear and does not alter the appearance of the stone. Particularly recommended for marble and quartzite in high-UV climates.

Can countertop protection film be removed without damaging the surface?

Yes — when properly installed and removed within the replacement window (3-5 years). Quality countertop protection films use pressure-sensitive adhesive that bonds securely during use but releases cleanly without adhesive residue on polished stone, quartz, or laminate surfaces.

Do you ship countertop film to Oregon and Washington?

Yes. We drop-ship to Portland, Seattle, Spokane, Eugene, Tacoma, Vancouver WA, Beaverton, and all Pacific Northwest metros. Ground transit from Phoenix is 2-4 business days depending on location.

Is there a minimum order for countertop film supply?

No minimum on your first order. Order a sample kit, a single cut sheet for one countertop, or a full roll. After your first order, trade accounts unlock volume pricing tiers based on recurring order volume.
